text:
#!name=嘀嗒出行
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = capis*.didapinche.com, adx-cn.anythinktech.com, www.didapinche.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capis(-\d)?\.didapinche\.com\/adbase/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capis(-\d)?\.didapinche\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/adx-cn\.anythinktech\.com\/bid/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/capis(-?\w*)?\.didapinche\.com\/publish\/api\/upgrade/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.didapinche\.com\/app\/adstat\//i then reject(200)
